genericProblem: An implementation-facing UI denominator can assign two distinct user tasks to one module path, causing implementation to choose between an approved business task and a contradictory final artifact.

counterexamples.reason: The selected-workspace account task remains correctly bound to workspace-iam/AccountsPage.tsx and must not be renamed.

counterexamples.path: IA03 organization, contract, role and extension surfaces
counterexamples.reason: These are different business tasks and were not found to share a contradictory route-backed page assignment.

findings.finding: The roster and physical contract bound PLATFORM-ADMIN-USERS and its administrator child surfaces to workspace-iam/AccountsPage, while IA03 and route registration bind the administrator task to platform-administration/AdministratorsPage.

preventionDispositions.reason: Before implementation, every catalog page final path must equal the physical import contract path and the route-registration module for the same business task; a mismatch is a design blocker, not an implementation choice.
